FG launches iDICE growth lab, backs eight start-ups with N1b
web.description:
## Get the morning briefing
Federal Government has officially launched the Growth Lab programme, under the [iDICE Startup Bridge initiative,](https://guardian.ng/business-services/fg-backed-idice-targets-early-stage-startups-with-350000/) backing eight Nigerian startups into a structured growth journey designed to strengthen their businesses, deepen their investment readiness, and position them for their next phase of growth with equity investment.

The selected start-ups for this cohort of the growth lab are GoDash (Last-mile Logistics, North-West), Telios (Energy, South-East), Vantrace (Regtech, South-West), KrosAI (AI, South-South), Leaflet (Agritech, South-East), Lenol (Mobility, South-South), 360gadgetsafrica (Ecommerce, North-Central), and SavvyBee (Fintech, South-West).

Growth Lab is the Federal Government’s commitment to backing that discipline with real capital and real support.
